The save path runs from `saveVisitNote` in the notes app, through a POST to `/encounter`, into `EncounterServiceImpl.saveEncounter`, and ends in `HibernateEncounterDAO.saveEncounter`. I used up the search budget before reading the generic `MainResourceController` POST handler, so that hop is inferred from the `DelegatingCrudResource.create` code rather than read directly.

**Chain, in order:**

1. **Frontend trigger:** `visit-notes-form.component.tsx` `onSubmit` builds the `VisitNotePayload` and calls `saveVisitNote` for new notes (or `updateVisitNote` when editing). It is at `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/notes/visit-notes-form.component.tsx:389-437`.
2. **Frontend request:** `saveVisitNote` POSTs to `${restBaseUrl}/encounter` with the JSON body (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/notes/visit-notes.resource.ts:134-143`).
3. **Server REST handler:** the `/encounter` POST is dispatched by `MainResourceController` (class at `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/.../controller/MainResourceController.java:54`; the POST method was not read). It calls `DelegatingCrudResource.create`, which converts the properties and calls `save()` (`openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/.../resource/impl/DelegatingCrudResource.java:74-86`).
4. **Resource `save`:** for the 1.9+ resource versions (the 2.2 resource extends 1.9), `EncounterResource1_9.save` attaches encounter providers and calls `Context.getEncounterService().saveEncounter` (`openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/.../resource/openmrs1_9/EncounterResource1_9.java:77-86`). The 1.8 version does the same without the provider fix-up (`.../openmrs1_8/EncounterResource1_8.java:188-191`).
5. **Core service:** `EncounterServiceImpl.saveEncounter` runs the edit-permission and visit checks, adjusts obs and orders, then calls `dao.saveEncounter` at line 173 (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/EncounterServiceImpl.java:100-174`).
6. **Data access:** `HibernateEncounterDAO.saveEncounter` calls `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate` on the current Hibernate session (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateEncounterDAO.java:79-82`). The row is written when the session flushes.
